name: COCO recap (Recap-COCO-30K)
note: COCO val2014 images (30k) with original human caption + LLaVA-1.5 recaption. Shows what 'recaptioned COCO' looks like.

name: COCO/LVIS GPT-4V 220k
note: 218k COCO images (LVIS split) captioned by GPT-4V. URLs point at images.cocodataset.org (stable).

name: PixMo-Cap (Ai2)
note: 717k images, dense captions built from human spoken descriptions (Molmo). URL list, mixed hosts.

name: PD12M (Spawning)
note: 12.4M public-domain/CC0 images, Florence-2 captions, images on Spawning's own S3 (stable).

name: Megalith-10M + ShareCaptioner
note: 10M Flickr 'photo'-class CC/PD images (Megalith), ShareCaptioner dense captions. Images fetched from Flickr URLs.

name: Pexels photo-concept-bucket
note: 568k Pexels stock photos with CogVLM captions. URL list to pexels.com.

name: CommonCatalog CC-BY (YFCC)
note: ~26M Flickr CC-BY photos (YFCC100M) with BLIP-2 captions, image bytes in parquet (21 TB total).

name: ImageNet-1k VL-enriched
note: ImageNet-1k (1.28M) with BLIP-2 captions and bboxes. Object-centric. Bytes in parquet, gated (accept terms).

name: LLaVA-ReCap-CC12M
note: CC12M web images recaptioned with LLaVA-NeXT (the closest relative of the dataset that disappointed before). Bytes in parquet, 465 GB.

name: PixelProse (RedCaps shard)
note: 16M web images (CommonPool/CC12M/RedCaps) with Gemini captions. URL list; this shard is the Reddit (RedCaps) part.

name: DenseFusion-1M (LAION)
note: 1M LAION images with very long multi-paragraph captions. Images also shipped as zips.

name: text-to-image-2M (synthetic)
note: 2M AI-generated 512px images (DALL-E 3 / FLUX style) with the generating prompt. Perfect caption fit, synthetic look.

name: FLUX-Reason-6M (synthetic)
note: 6M FLUX.1-dev images with multi-facet captions. Synthetic; this shard is the 'Aesthetics' part.

name: DOCCI (Google)
note: 15k photos with very detailed human-written descriptions (~136 words). Tiny but the gold standard for caption quality.

name: SA-1B @512² + Qwen2.5-VL (BLIP3o)
note: The 11M SA-1B (Segment Anything) licensed stock photographs, centre-cropped to 512², with Qwen2.5-VL-7B captions. 1,000 tars, 565 GB. Meta's SA-1B terms are research-only.

name: Megalith-10M mirror (moondream mdqa)
note: 5.46M Megalith Flickr photos as bytes in parquet (1.06 TB, 1024 px max side) with one-sentence Moondream captions. Richer captions (Qwen3-VL-30B, InternVL2, Florence-2) exist as separate join tables.

name: Open Images + Qwen3-VL captions
note: 1.76M Open Images V7 photos (Flickr CC-BY) as bytes in parquet (580 GB, up to 1024 px) with object-focused Qwen3-VL-30B captions capped at 256 tokens.

name: Pexels 2.8M @256² (i1 TFRecord)
note: Pexels stock photos already centre-cropped and resized to 256² (PNG) by the i1 authors, 128 shards, 269 GB, MIT tag. Each record carries five Qwen3-VL-30B captions. Same photographer pool as photo-concept-bucket but 5x larger and ready at training resolution.
